decisions.reason: As a large growing coding-and-marking firm with strong in-house R&D, the printer is very close to its existing knowledge base, so management is likely to retain it and use early market feedback to refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.

The software module directly extends the firm’s established inline printing systems and fits its strategic move toward digitalization and traceability, making it highly likely that the firm keeps and develops it further.

This coder builds on the firm’s established inkjet and substrate expertise and serves a clear customer need, so despite some application risk management would usually keep it on the market to exploit and deepen related capabilities.
